strategic_priorities.text: Focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas; goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term.

strategic_priorities.quote: Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents.

strategic_priorities.text: Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services.
strategic_priorities.quote: Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more.

strategic_priorities.text: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.
strategic_priorities.quote: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

strategic_priorities.text: We prioritize security above all else and offer customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy.
strategic_priorities.quote: We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets.

strategic_priorities.text: Commitment to designing and deploying AI responsibly with safety and security from the outset.
strategic_priorities.quote: We believe AI should be as empowering as it is powerful, and we’re committed to designing and deploying AI responsibly with safety and security from the outset.

strategic_priorities.text: Sustainability: goals announced in 2020 to become a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030.

strategic_priorities.text: Plan to continue to make significant investments in a broad range of product research and development activities, coordinated across operating segments, including continuing to support fundamental research.
strategic_priorities.quote: We plan to continue to make significant investments in a broad range of product research and development activities, and as appropriate, we will coordinate our research and development across operating segments and leverage the results across the company.

segments.name: Productivity and Business Processes
segments.note: Document states segment composition changes announced in August 2024, most notably bringing the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together in this segment, effective beginning fiscal year 2025.
segments.quote: These changes align our segments with how we currently manage our business, most notably bringing the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together in the Productivity and Business Processes segment.

segments.name: Intelligent Cloud
segments.quote: We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

segments.name: More Personal Computing
segments.quote: Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology.
